WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, p.category AS cat_was,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND NOT (s.store_id = 900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, p.category, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, cp.category AS cat_asis, n.cat_was, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS net_sales, COUNT(*) AS n_rows
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_period = 8
  AND (cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical') OR n.cat_was IN ('Garden','Electrical'))
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY 1,3,4

WITH lines AS (
  SELECT f.*, d.fiscal_year, cp.category AS cat
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 29 AND 36
    AND cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical')
)
SELECT fiscal_year,
  COUNT(*) AS n,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_line_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_receipt_line,
  COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS n_loads,
  MIN(etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS max_load,
  SUM(CASE WHEN net_amount<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg_lines,
  SUM(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos_qty,
  SUM(CASE WHEN channel_code='WB' OR channel_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS web_lines,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order w WHERE w.status NOT IN ('delivered','collected')) AS nondelivered_orders_all
FROM lines GROUP BY fiscal_year ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, (w.web_order_id IS NULL AND s.store_id = 900) AS orphan_web, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, FALSE, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT orphan_web THEN net_sales END),2) AS excl_nondispatched,
    ROUND(SUM(net_sales),2) AS incl_nondispatched
  FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_period = 8 GROUP BY 1
),
ctl AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, ROUND(SUM(r.net_sales),2) AS rpt_net_sales
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
  WHERE r.store_id <> 999 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_period = 8 GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT * FROM mine JOIN ctl USING (fiscal_year) ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
by_year AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cp.category, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
      AND cp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.category, 8 AS fiscal_period,
       ty.fiscal_year AS fiscal_year, ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales,
       ly.fiscal_year AS comparison_fiscal_year, ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS comparison_net_sales,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM by_year ty
JOIN by_year ly ON ly.category = ty.category AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY ty.category
